verses: How gay and volatile you are, When upon Yuan Ch'iu's top you stand! Kindly you are indeed, but want All that would men's respect command.
How at the foot of Yuan Ch'iu's height Your blows upon the drum resound! In winter and in summer, there With egret's plume in hand you're found.
To Yuan Ch'iu as you move along, You beat your sounding earthenware. In winter and in summer both, Your fan of egret's plumes you bear.
